head: codex/63-implemented-sip-scope-correction-preparation
title: [C-SDLC v2] Allow audited implemented SIP scope correction
body:
Closes #63

Adds the bounded typed SIP declared-scope correction at Implemented, including fail-closed review/publication guards and typed review recovery for stale Implemented review truth.

Focused proof: Gate 2 real-CLI correction regression, Gate 5 recovery regression, authorization unit matrix, strict Clippy, typed validation/doctor, and exact-head independent review.
